Question 4
?

Which of the following is equivalent to ∫Cyexdx, where C is the path along a circle of radius 2, traversed from the point (0,2) to the point (−2,0), as shown above?

Hint: Use the parametrization r(t)=⟨2cos⁡t,2sin⁡t⟩.

a
2∫π/2πe2sin⁡tcos⁡tdt
b
−4∫π/2πe2cos⁡tsin⁡tdt
c
−2∫π/2πe2cos⁡tsin⁡tdt
d
−4∫π/2πe2cos⁡tsin2⁡tdt
e
4∫π/2πe2sin⁡tcos2⁡tdt
